free_tier.stated: 'Unlimited Storage — Upload as many Videos as you wish. Active files will be saved'.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: No stated bandwidth cap; 'unlimited upload/download speed' claimed. Ad-monetised, so egress is the product.

tooling: Documented API at https://streamtape.com/api with account info, download ticket, get download link, file info and upload endpoints. Widely integrated into upload bots.
chaining: Free accounts x unlimited storage x unlimited files. Video-only in practice (it is a streaming host); the useful play is media/checkpoint shards, not raw datasets.
limits_note: Video formats only; files are encoded/re-encoded on ingest (lossy for anything not already a video). 'Active files' only are kept. Inactive files are purged. Downloads require a generated ticket.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Re-encoding destroys byte fidelity, so it cannot store arbitrary binaries. Ticket-gated downloads and ad-injected players make unattended fetch fragile. Activity requirement is unquantified on the pages read.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

evidence.proved: 'Unlimited Storage ... Active files will be saved on a system of safe and secured servers'
API sections: Account Infos, generate Download Ticket, get Download Link, check File Info, Upload
